protocol.sampling: Exact stored control plans/inputs/labels/core masks;no added supervised cells
protocol.loss: Original patch State RMSE + .05*speed-difference RMSE on consecutive core cells both already supervised and float32 abs(delta truth)>=.8 normalized
protocol.loss_budget: Extra pair objective,not extra labels. Pair counts stored at endpoint;no flow pair term or other coefficient trial
protocol.controls: A104 queue models reused from verified exports,not refitted
protocol.checkpoint: Pure ordinary cal State every4epochs,first maximum
protocol.primary: New2seed mean only if cal gain>=.0005 and no regime loss>.001,else keep original NN
protocol.assessment: Viewed old public assessment,read after both new fits and selection seal
protocol.future_scope: Registered before fitting. Public research dates,other historical studies possible,not final/private

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights
